sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Charchit Shastri - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Apoorv Joshi- Government Advocate for responden
 Order
This second application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for grant of bail.

2. The applicant has been arrested on 17.01.2022 in connection with Crime No.24/2022 registered at Police Station Kshipra, District Indore for offence under Section 376(2)(D), 376(2)(N), 377, 323,
294, 506 and 34 of IPC and under Section 25 of Arms Act.
3. The first application was dismissed by a coordinate Bench of this Court.
4. The Hon'ble Judge who had rejected the first application has been transferred, therefore this case has been listed before this Court.
5. Prosecutrix has been examined and she supported the prosecution case.

6. In the light of judgment passed by the Supreme Court in the case of Satish Jaggi vs. State of Chhatishgarh , reported in (2007) 11 SCC 195 , this NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-IND:26842 2 MCRC-7733-2024 Court cannot consider liability/credibility of the evidence of the witnesses.
